question: 3 right circular cylinders having the same base radius (r cm) and the same height (h cm) are placed one upon the other, to form another right cylinder whose radius of base is also r cm. The total surface area (in *cm*²) of this new right cylindrical solid so formed is:
solution:

Base radius of each cylinder = r cm

Height of each cylinder = h cm

3 right circular cylinders are placed one upon the other to form a new right circular cylinder.

**Formula Used:**

Total surface area of a right circular cylinder = Curved Surface Area + Area of two bases
